entities.name: PMID:25079933
observations: Randomized prospective early-RA study; 225 participants, prednisolone 7.5 mg/day for two years versus no prednisolone; radiographic progression assessed by modified Sharp/van der Heijde score.

entities.name: Antibody prediction by treatment
observations: At two years, RF and anti-CCP independently predicted radiographic progression in the no-prednisolone group (OR 9.4, 95% CI 2.5–35.2; OR 8.7, 95% CI 2.5–31.3); neither predicted progression in the prednisolone group. Progression occurred in 26% versus 39% overall (prednisolone versus control; p=0.033).
